name: Mutant Massacre
description: Mr. Sinister's Marauders descend into the Morlock Tunnels and systematically slaughter the mutant outcasts living beneath New York. The X-Men arrive to find carnage—and a trap that will cost them dearly.
flavorText: The tunnels run red. The Marauders show no mercy.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Terror / Horror Sting. Marauder slaughter in the Morlock Tunnels. Brutal stabbing brass and dying strings. Dark and merciless, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
